newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.13/5.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.13/5.25 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $23.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Monday is expected to produce average rates of 5.13 percent and 5.25 percent, respectively, traders said.
In when-issued trade at around 1255 EST/1755 GMT, three-month bill rates were quoted at 5.125 percent. Six-month bill rates were quoted at 5.255 percent.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
